verdict.taxonomy: internal receiver standard versus external free atomic standard
verdict.design: co-located differencing strongly suppresses common site, satellite and network terms; residual distance structure is consistent with a screening prediction, with receiver/antenna/processing systematics retained as alternatives
verdict.discriminator: TEP screening predicts a replicated distance-structured residual at the established scale; generic local noise does not
verdict.strongest_controlled_anchor: MAT1-MATE (same Leica GR30 receiver model and firmware epochs)
verdict.limitation: site is the independent replication unit; days and distant stations increase precision within a site but do not increase the number of independent anchors. INTERNAL is not a material identification, so a direct oscillator-output experiment is still required for quartz-specific screening.
